slice: Persistent shell rail product graph polish
intent: Polish the always-present shell rail so the dashboard reads as one cohesive FD-001 product graph dogfooding Oyatie Cloud, with Messenger, Mail, and Community visible as built-in workloads.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Changed the persistent Work Hub rail label from Messenger · Mail to Messenger · Mail · Community in both hydrated and static SSR rail markup.
Added a top-of-rail FD-001 tenant workload proof card tying Product graph, Oyatie Cloud, REC-WF-7741, cell-us-east-2, and local-only routes together before any navigation groups.
Added four rail proof actions: Product graph, Cloud, Evidence, and Work hub.
Wired rail proof actions to service catalog/product graph, cloud topology, audit ledger, and built-in Community surface without backend, workflow, mail, deploy, billing, IAM, or cloud mutation.
Styled the proof card and selected/hover states using existing paper, rule, accent, radius, shadow, mono, and text-scale tokens.

responsive_assertions.note: Existing shell hides the left rail below 72rem; proof markup remains present, and no console errors were recorded.

summary.note: Secondary debug diff over the persistent left rail crop; changes are intentional rail proof/status/label additions.

visual_verdict.category_match: Cohesive persistent FD-001/Oyatie Cloud product graph rail
visual_verdict.reasoning: The persistent shell rail now immediately names FD-001 tenant workloads, Oyatie Cloud, REC-WF-7741, and the built-in Messenger/Mail/Community workload set. It provides visible proof actions that route to the product graph, cloud topology, evidence ledger, and Work Hub while preserving explicit local-only boundaries.
differences: Rail actions remain visual-only and deliberately do not execute workflows, send mail/messages, mutate IAM/auth, change billing, deploy resources, or mutate cloud/provider state.
The existing responsive shell hides the left rail below 72rem; this slice preserves that behavior rather than redesigning mobile navigation.
suggestions: A future mobile-specific command sheet can mirror the persistent proof routes when the responsive navigation pattern is revisited.
